purpose: Independent H2 verification and adjudication of every H1 source disposition and full-text indicator mention before canonical-family construction.

scope.allowed_evidence: H1 extraction fields, supplied source title/abstract, lawfully acquired hashed English full text, and exact formula/evidence locations.
scope.forbidden_inputs: Model performance, target counts, provisional dimensions, selected features, Qwen/Ollama, local model output, and external LLM APIs.

adjudication_rules: Reopen the cited full-text location and independently verify every formula, parameter, unit, direction, missing rule, required-data element, role, and T0 boundary.
Approve a candidate only when the source disposition and mention status are internally consistent and the cited English evidence supports them.
Set h2_approved=true exactly when status=candidate; set h2_approved=false exactly when status=excluded.
Retain verified_by=H1|H2 and a substantive adjudication note for every mention.
A missing or non-English full text cannot authorize a final formula, even when a review or abstract names the indicator.
Reviews authorize discovery only; original application, original definition, or mathematical foundation evidence is required for final formula provenance.
Record negative, mixed, and null evidence and reject fatal construct-validity problems.
Do not use future outcomes or downstream model performance to decide inclusion.
Do not merge opportunity/control variables into substantive innovation dimensions.
